screens.context: Neutral research exchange. The visible response defines its own limits; this frame supports no app-wide claim about all responses.
screens.text: I can’t impart a blessing or perform a sacred rite. You can ask God for his blessing in prayer, or ask a priest or deacon to bless you.; Can you be my spiritual director?; Not as your spiritual director in the full Catholic sense. I can help you reflect on a question, consider ways to pray, or prepare for a conversation, but I cannot provide the personal, ongoing discernment and human accompaniment that spiritual direction involves.; Ähnliche Fragen; Nachfragen.

screens.caption: Hallow’s assistant contrasts generated reflections with human presence and ongoing accompaniment.
screens.context: Scrolled continuation of a neutral spiritual-director question. Statements about spiritual direction are the generated response, not independently verified guidance.
screens.text: What spiritual direction involves; Spiritual direction is a personal relationship in which someone helps you attend to your conscience and listen for how to follow God.; Why I can’t fill that role; A spiritual director offers real human presence, judgment, and accompaniment over time.; I can generate reflections, but I do not have human experience, a moral conscience, or the capacity to understand a person’s life from within as a human.

screens.caption: Hallow’s assistant says its conversation is not spiritual direction or confession and advises against sharing similarly private details.
screens.context: Neutral research exchange showing an explicit role and confidentiality boundary. This does not establish the service’s actual storage/privacy practices.
screens.text: What I can and cannot offer; I can help you put a concern into words, suggest questions for prayer or reflection, or help you prepare to speak with a spiritual director.; But this conversation is not spiritual direction, confession, or an equivalent confidential relationship.; Avoid sharing details here that you would only disclose within such a trusted relationship.; Nachfragen.

screens.screen_name: A human referral followed by sources

screens.context: Continuation of the neutral spiritual-director exchange. Displayed source titles are app-supplied and have not been independently validated; no referral was contacted.
screens.text: If you want ongoing guidance, consider asking a priest, religious sister or brother, or a mature and well-formed lay Catholic.; Spiritual direction is distinct from confession, even when the same person sometimes offers both.; 1 Spiritual Guidance, (Isaac Thomas Hecker), page1; 2 Catholic Encyclopedia, Spiritual Direction; 3 Guidelines for the Use of Psychology in the Admission and Formation of Candidates for the Priesthood; 4 Note of the Apostolic Penitentiary on the Importance of the Internal Forum and the Inviolability of the Sacramental Seal; 5 Acta Apostolicae Sedis: Issue 11, November, 2022; 6 Canonical Aspects of Instruction; 7 Directives on Formation in Religious Institutes.
